Per key: the setup's league settings = the player.json committed on its late-entry branch (source commit:path, sha256 pinned; never edited here, only base_url is replaced in the stub tests); kind chat (chat form: system + user, answer constrained to the item's JSON schema, as Kimi/GLM in Part 2) or decision (decision form: state, instructions, options, as Celeris/Jev/d1-ultra); stub = the late-tiny8 stub_server.py kind (@ 8ebad40, branch late-tiny8-small3) standing in for its server; server = where it would be served; league_ms_le4 = median request_ms of its valid League 1 decisions with at most 4 legal plays (v3.db, read-only, 2026-11-13; n = league_n_le4); est_ms = the stand-in per-request time of a model without a league record (est_basis).
